page.layout: Running head at top left and page number at top right. Main text in one column, with notes in a narrow column in the right margin. Two centred headings (TITVL. XXVII. and TITVL. XXVIII.) stand in the text, each with a decorated initial. Signature centred at the foot.

main_text.p: liano {4}si {b}tamē ei filio neque suus heres sit,quive {c}inter suos heredes ad bonorum possessionem à Praetore vocatur: neque pater ad quem lege hereditas, bonorumve possessio cum re pertinet, neque frater consanguineus. Quòd si soror consanguinea sit, ad vtrasque {d}pertinere iubetur hereditas.v.§.2.Inst. de Senatusc. Tertull.Quando mater succedat filio.vt emancipatus.v.l.2. Cod. Theodof.de-cund. nupt.
main_text.head: TITVL. XXVII. DE LIBERTORVM SVCCESSIONIBVS vel bonis.
main_text.p: LIBERTORVM intestatorum heredi-tas primùm ad suos s heredes perti-net: deinde ad eos quorum liberti sunt, velut patronum, patronam, liberósve patroni.§.3.Inst.17.Instit. de successs. libert. in pr.
2 Si vt patronus, & alterius patroni filius, ad solum patronum hereditas pertinet.l.23. §.1.ff. de bon. libert. in pr.
4 Ad liberos patronorum, hereditas defuncti pertinet, vt in capita {h}, non in stirpes diuidatur.dixi ad l.23. inf.ff. de bon.libertor.
5 Legitimae[?] hereditatis ius, quod ex lege duodecim Tabularum descendit, capitis minutione amittitur.3.Instit.10. 37.ff.1.
main_text.head: TITVL. XXVIII. DE POSSESSIONIBVS DANDIS.
main_text.p: BONORVM possessio datur aut contra tabulas testamenti, aut aduersus {l}tabulas intestati.v.§.2.l.eo.§.5.l.cod.4. & 6. Cod. 12.ideft, secundum. v.10. §.14 §.cod.

2 Contra {m}tabulas bonorum possessio datur liberis emancipatis, {n}testamento praeteritis {o}, licet legitima ad eos non pertineat hereditas.§.3.Instit. de bonor.poss.ff. & 37.ff.Inst. & suis, sive sint naturales, sive legitimi, sive posthumi. §.3. l.d. §3.

3 Bonorum possessio contra tabulas liberis tam {p}naturalibus, quàm adoptiuis datur. Sed naturalibus quidem emancipatis: non tamen & illis, qui in adoptiua familia sunt. Adoptiuis autem, his tantùm, qui in potestate manserunt.l.1.ff.de bonor. poss. contra tabulas.

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "Legitimae" (drop-cap area, first letters partly unclear, marked [?]); "adoptiuis" (line-start partly cut, read from context). "suos s heredes": a stray long-s glyph before "heredes" is unclear. The note after "l" in "aduersus l" appears twice (letters "lx" and "l"); both are transcribed as printed with the second flagged as uncertain. The reference "e" sits beside the first heading and is attached to the following paragraph. Note "Theodof.de-cund. nupt." has a line-break hyphen that may hide a letter. The first line of the page is cut at the left edge ("liano" for Iuliano).
